newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends up vs dollar, basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends up vs dollar, basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint finished slightly firmer against the dollar due to a stronger mark and because it closed a gap of some four fillers with the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (NBH bid), dealers said.
The forint ended at 155.51/56 to the dollar, compared with 155.58/63 at midday and 155.60/65 at the opening.
"We tracked the dollar/mark and the dollar is a little weaker," said Peter Piros of Europai Kereskedelmi Bank.
The forint floats against a basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu, within the NBH's 4.5-percent wide intervention range.
Dealers said they did not see factors that would move the forint away from the NBH bid by more than a few pips this week.
Most dollar and yen futures on the Budapest Commodity Exchange rose, while the mark closed mixed.
The yen was the feature, accounting for most of the 3.12 billion forint turnover in Wednesday's session.
